summary.en:
- Skill and Ultimate activate "Divine Provision". This heals and cleanses allies at the beginning of their turn, and heals them after they use their Ultimate; meeting these conditions also heals any ally below 50% HP.
- Ultimate grants a teamwide ATK% buff, and restores 20% of her other party members' Max Energy. This can make her a strong teammate to Energy-reliant characters.
- Her healing is decent, and her cleansing and teamwide buffs are among the best among sustains.
- Lacks damage reduction or automatic emergency healing, so her teams are prone to one-shots. This can force allies to delay Ultimates to trigger healing.

details.en:
- E1 allows Talent's "Divine Provision" to grant the team a 12% SPD buff and lasts 1 extra turn. It also increases Outgoing Healing by 20%, improving her consistency by making it easier to rely on Ultimate to refresh "Divine Provision" without ever using Skill. The 12% SPD can be impactful if it allows your team to hit meaningful breakpoints; can allow DPS to focus on offensive substats over SPD, and supports to reach 200 SPD.
- S1 [[light-cone:night-of-fright]] provides [[stat:err]] for Huohuo, healing for an ally when they uses their Ultimate, as well as an [[stat:atk]] buff when they receive healing. This is a decent pick, but Huohuo has access to other viable options.
